question: Which of the following medications is an anti CD20 monoclonal antibody used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody" -> "Targets CD20 antigen on B cells" -> "Reduces B cell activity" -> "Decreases inflammation in rheumatoid arthritis" -> "Used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis" -> 95%
analysis: Rituximab is an anti CD20 monoclonal antibody used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.
